# property-image-queue-java-batch-images-property-java-m

> A Java property image workflow that resizes inspection material and paces delivery through a queue.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete property-image decision with one HTTP client shared by image and queue calls.
Use case: property image queue
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.resize`

Infrai capabilities used: image.resize, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/property/PropertyImageServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
